lines: Two kinds of staff now share the admin console. Admins can do everything; Moderators look after members.
A Moderator's navigation lists only the Dashboard and Members. Events and Services never appear.
Open Events or Services by its address, and Admins only takes its place. The heading takes focus, and the address bar keeps where you were going.
Go to dashboard takes a Moderator straight back to their work.
Change someone's role while they work, and their next move follows the new role, with no new sign-in.
On the server, every admin endpoint takes the rule of its area from where it is routed, and the role is read from the database on every request.
One table decides it, the same in both stacks. A new area stays closed to Moderators until it is named.
Every test failed first. Now they all pass.
Next, an audit of every staff change.
That's slice twenty-nine point one. Christian Fitness: a Christian community for health in body and spirit.
